purpose: Finish the original full-space residuals from the corrected physical checkpoints with one bounded checked response-space restart
trigger: Both saved states meet reduced self-consistency but retain full-space residuals above the unchanged 1e-5 Hartree target
restart: Retain the complete occupied ensemble to numerical precision and its original mean-field input; verify density, trace, spin and full-Hamiltonian energy retention
unchanged: Physical functional, epsilon=1, maximum space dimension 192, response counts and every accuracy tolerance
outer_solver: Exact elimination of the auxiliary coordinate in the same variational functional
stopping: Original full stationarity/self-consistency conditions, or capacity; do not repeat an unchanged state after capacity is exhausted
reference_use: Existing labels only after the solve stops; no energy-error stopping or new references
limits: Development convergence completion, not a blind test
No speed work or rank/seed/tolerance sweep
Global Fock-vector backend and finite bases
